verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs have a dedicated JavaScript 'Uploading Source Maps' page, and sentry-cli is described as primarily used for 'release and source maps management' and for uploading release artifacts. That covers the CLI path for getting source maps into Sentry for symbolicated JS stack traces. Most of this rests on page titles and one-line summaries rather than detailed content. Missing for 10: any evidence of a bundler plugin (webpack/Vite/etc.), explicit CI-pipeline workflow documentation, an explicit description of de-minified production frames, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
